components.local_changes: Initial deterministic engine, CPU contract and scheduler
Host-independent address-space bus with an optional observer for deterministic external traces
Host-allocated RAM and ROM regions with endian-neutral bus transactions

Replaced global CPU state and legacy memory coupling with explicit state and bus transactions; added tested arithmetic flags, conditional flow, ModR/M effective addresses with explicit ES/CS/SS/DS overrides, ROM-checksum and memory-check operations including immediate word moves and masking and repeated word stores/scans, full basic-register inspection, and callback-based real-mode interrupt entry to the still-incomplete V30 subset

Replaced global devices, host timers and direct CPU coupling with opaque single-instance 8259A and deterministic 8253 contracts; PIC pending output and vector acknowledge now cross explicit callbacks, while only the XT PIC path and binary PIT modes 0, 2 and 3 are implemented
Initial opaque session lifecycle and typed machine factory
Deterministic host adapter for tests and headless use
Minimal frontend proving that Qt is optional

Isolated the documented V30, RAM, ROM, single PIC, PIT and minimum motherboard register map behind a typed machine factory; added explicit PIC-to-CPU interrupt routing, early BIOS diagnostic latches, an opaque port-70h memory-control latch and selector-only EMS register boundary, while the EMS aperture, keyboard queues, RTC, DMA and peripherals remain absent
